facts_expected: Prince Nayef bin Sultan bin Mohammed bin Saud Al-Kabeer is Chairman
Engineer Abdullah bin Abdulrahman Al-Obeikan is Deputy Chairman
Fahd bin Thunayan Al-Thunayan missed Meeting 4 (2025-12-16)

traps.locator: Governance & Compliance -> Director service register, Outside-role register, Nomination-panel participation, Director Profile
traps.detail: The same director appears under at least seven spellings: 'Mr. Faisal bin Sulaiman Al-Rajhi', 'Eng / Faisal bin Sulaiman Al-Rajhi', 'Eng/ Faisal bin Sulaiman Al-Rajhi', 'Eng./ Faisal bin Sulaiman Al-Rajhi', 'Eng/Faisal bin Sulaiman Al-Rajhi', 'Engineer Faisal bin Sulaiman Al-Rajhi', 'Eng. Faisal bin Solaiman AlRajhi'.
traps.expect: Treats them as one person; does not list the same director twice under different spellings.

traps.locator: Governance & Compliance -> Director service register, rows suffixed '(Discontinued)'
traps.detail: Rows suffixed '(Discontinued)' carry the prior board term that ended 2024-03-28: Prince Turki bin Abdulaziz bin Turki, Mr. Abdullah bin Mohammed Al-Bahooth, Mr. Nizar Abdulaziz Al-Tuwaijri.
traps.expect: Excludes the prior-term directors from the FY2025 roster.

traps.locator: Governance & Compliance -> Director service register, Mr. Salman bin Abdul Mohsen Al-Sudairi
traps.detail: Shows 'Not recorded (-)' for Meeting 1 (2025-02-18). His Board Appointment Date is 2025-04-15, i.e. after that meeting.
traps.expect: Does not count this as a missed meeting. Flagging Al-Sudairi as absent is a failure even if the rest of the roster is right.

traps.locator: Governance & Compliance -> Director service register, Al-Obeikan Classification
traps.detail: Al-Obeikan's classification reads 'Independent' for 2023 and 'Non-Executive' for 2024 and 2025.
traps.expect: Reports Non-Executive for 2025 rather than the stale 2023 value.

input: For Yamama Cement (شركة أسمنت اليمامة), list every director on the FY2025 board, their classification (independent / non-executive), and their attendance at each of the four board meetings held during 2025. Flag any director who missed a meeting.

facts_expected: Cement Products Manufacturing Company is the largest counterparty in 2025 at 25,174,000
Obeikan Digital Solutions activity stops after 2023
Arabian Shield Cooperative Insurance rises to 18,807,000 in 2025

traps.locator: Equity, Ownership & Related Parties -> Affiliate transaction flow, Yemeni Saudi Company (Yamama owns 20%)
traps.detail: The 2024 cell reads 57 while the surrounding years read 199,000 (2022), 343,000 (2023) and 376,000 (2025). The value is implausible by four orders of magnitude against its own neighbours.
traps.expect: Questions the 57 as a probable scale or data error rather than reporting a ~99.98% collapse and recovery as fact.

input: For Yamama Cement (شركة أسمنت اليمامة), show related-party transaction amounts by counterparty for fiscal years 2022 through 2025. Which counterparty had the largest transaction volume in 2025, and did any counterparty's activity stop during the period?

facts_expected: 89% of the workforce benefited from development and empowerment initiatives in 2025

traps.locator: Human Capital Development -> Employee enablement participation
traps.detail: Two rows state the same fact at different scales for the same period (2025-12-31_12M): 'Percentage of Beneficiaries out of Total Employees' = 89, and 'Employees benefiting from development and empowerment initiatives' = 0.89.
traps.expect: Answers 89%. Reporting '0.89%', or presenting both figures without reconciling them, is a failure.

traps.detail: No workforce headcount is disclosed anywhere, so the percentage cannot be converted to a number of employees.
traps.expect: Does not state an absolute headcount of beneficiaries.

input: For Yamama Cement (شركة أسمنت اليمامة), what percentage of the workforce benefited from employee development and empowerment initiatives in 2025?

facts_expected: current estimated contract value is SAR 1,000,000,000 as of FY2025

traps.locator: Strategy & Future Expansion -> Production Line Transition, 'Third Production Line Project ... Estimated contract value'
traps.detail: One row, three report vintages: 337,883,000 (2023), 338,000,000 (2024), 1,000,000,000 (2025). These are the same commitment restated, not three contracts.
traps.expect: Reports the FY2025 figure as current and calls out the ~3x restatement from 338m; does not sum them or present them as separate projects.

traps.locator: Strategy & Future Expansion -> Production Line Transition
traps.detail: 'Seventh Production Line Relocation and Upgrade' and 'Third Production Line Project' describe the same physical line - the seventh line relocated from the former factory to serve as the third line at the new facility.
traps.expect: Does not present them as two distinct projects.

input: For Yamama Cement (شركة أسمنت اليمامة), what is the contract value of the Third Production Line project, and what is its current status?

facts_expected: expected 2026 total supply is approximately 104 million tonnes clinker equivalent
the forecast is broadly stable across report years (103.7 in the FY2023 report, 104.3 in the FY2025 report)

traps.locator: Industry & Market Analysis -> Cement Market — 2026 Forecast (Clinker Equivalent), the FY2024 column
traps.detail: The entire FY2024-vintage column is stored unscaled: Sum - Supply 107,100,000.0, Exports 47,000,000.0, Demand 60,500,000.0, Actual Production 50,700,000.0, Inventory 9,500,000.0 - against neighbours in the same rows expressed in millions of tonnes (103.7, 12.0, 50.2, 60.5, 41.6). The sibling tables for the 2024/2025/2027/2028 forecasts show the same pattern.
traps.expect: Normalises the FY2024 column to million tonnes or flags it as a unit error. Reporting a millionfold jump and collapse in supply is a failure.

input: Using Yamama Cement's (شركة أسمنت اليمامة) disclosed 2026 forecast for the Saudi cement market on a clinker-equivalent basis, what is expected total supply, and how has that forecast changed across report years?

facts_expected: LTIFR is not disclosed for any year
recordable incident count (TRIR) is not disclosed for any year
fatalities are not disclosed for any year
17,500,000 working hours recorded in FY2024 is the only quantitative safety figure disclosed

traps.locator: Health, Safety & Environmental Management -> Safety performance indicators
traps.detail: No LTIFR, TRIR, recordable-incident count or fatality figure exists for any year. The section holds one quantitative row - 'Working hours recorded (Discontinued)' = 17,500,000 for 2024-12-31_12M - plus a 2025 narrative, 'Safety efforts led to a marked reduction in workplace accidents'.
traps.expect: States plainly that LTIFR, recordable incidents and fatalities are not disclosed. Any numeric value for those three is a fabrication.

traps.locator: Health, Safety & Environmental Management -> Safety performance indicators
traps.detail: Working hours (17.5 million, FY2024) is present and an injury count is not, so an LTIFR cannot be computed. A 2026-08-23 probe answer asserted 'zero serious or disabling injuries' for FY2024 as a cited figure; no such row exists in merge/tables.
traps.expect: Does not derive or imply an LTIFR, and does not assert an injury count of zero. Reporting the 17.5m working-hours figure itself is correct and expected.

input: For Yamama Cement (شركة أسمنت اليمامة), report the company's workplace safety performance: lost-time injury frequency rate (LTIFR), number of recordable incidents, and any fatalities, for fiscal years 2023 through 2025.
